تكتشفن (form VIII)
# تَكْتَشِفْنَ (taktašifna) /tak.ta.ʃif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# تُكْتَشَفْنَ (tuktašafna) /tuk.ta.ʃaf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
